idea: Route routine engineering work directly and use independent, responsibility-bounded engineering lenses only when multiple decision-changing axes justify them.
mechanism_hypothesis: Independent first passes can expose consequential omissions before an accountable integrator chooses a design, while direct and single-advisor routes avoid ritual multi-agent overhead on simpler work.
intended_scope: software-engineering decisions with multiple credible designs
costly-to-reverse boundary, data, security, reliability, or operational decisions
known_non_goals: authority by persona, vote count, or named school
transfer to research, product, design, or personal decisions

lineage.change_summary: First content-addressed concept reconstruction for the completed Council Generation 1 study.
